title: Decompose Chat workbench route into child components and state helpers
description:
Problem: `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Chat.razor` is now 2,511 lines and combines top-level route markup with transcript rendering, history/trace sidebar UI, browser storage/session parsing, attachment lifecycle, JS interop, and send/approval orchestration in one file. The architecture backlog owns `ChatServices.cs`, but no task currently owns the route component hotspot itself.

Evidence from 2026-05-26 audit:
- Largest-file scan listed `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Chat.razor` at 2,511 lines.
- `Chat.razor` switches into a large `@code` block at line 392 and retains local storage, trace, attachment, JS interop, and session-state responsibilities there.
- Search of `Data/Tasks` found no first-class decomposition task for `Chat.razor` or route-level chat component boundaries.
- Recent chat tasks such as `TSK-0163` and `TSK-0188` continue to land in this same route file.

Desired outcome: preserve current chat and agent behavior while splitting the route into bounded child components and focused state/serialization helpers.

Scope:
- In scope: transcript rendering, sidebar/history/trace panels, composer/attachment UI, stored-session parsing helpers, and route-owned state helpers.
- In scope: characterization coverage needed before or during extraction.
- Out of scope: changing provider semantics, chat product behavior, or write-approval policy.

Dependencies:
- Coordinate with `TSK-0042` and `TSK-0049` so UI and service extraction boundaries stay aligned.

Acceptance criteria:
- `Chat.razor` is materially reduced and no longer owns transcript rendering, sidebar/trace UI, composer/attachments, and storage parsing in one file.
- Existing chat behavior remains compatible under focused tests and route smoke coverage.
- Future chat UI tasks can target bounded child components rather than the top-level route file.

Validation:
- Run focused chat markup/component tests and affected `PagesAndChatTests` or successor fixtures.
- Run route-smoke or equivalent browser checks for `/chat`.
- Run `./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1` after task creation/update.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created during the 2026-05-26 untracked-gap audit after confirming the active architecture backlog still does not own the `Chat.razor` route hotspot even though the route remains the largest file in the app.
